help.title: 🤖 Sloth Bot - Help & Wiki
help.welcome: Welcome to Sloth! I'm a comprehensive Discord moderation and management bot.
help.legal_desc: Terms of Service and Privacy Policy
help.note_rework: Note: this bot is completely reworked and settings from the old version will not carry over.
help.overview_intro: Sloth is designed to help server administrators manage their communities effectively.
help.feature_moderation: **Advanced Moderation** - Powerful tools for maintaining order
help.feature_roles: **Role Management** - Timed roles, select roles, and verification
help.feature_embeds: **Embed Creator** - Create and manage custom embeds
help.step1: 1. All systems are available to use immediately
help.step2: 2. Configure each system using setup commands
help.step3: 3. Start managing your server more effectively!
help.systems_intro: Sloth offers several modular systems that can be independently activated:
help.system_moderation_desc:
• Kick, ban, timeout users
• Message purging and slowmode
• Comprehensive moderation logging
help.system_warning_desc:
• Issue warnings with severity levels
• Automatic actions on thresholds
• Warning history tracking
help.system_ticket_desc:
• Professional support channels
• Staff assignment and priorities
help.system_logchannel_desc:
• Dedicated logging channels
• Track server events
• Comprehensive audit trail
help.system_statistics_desc:
• Server activity tracking
• Daily and weekly reports
• Engagement metrics
help.system_rules_desc:
• Custom rules embeds with verification buttons
• Role assignment upon verification
• Verification statistics tracking
help.system_verify_desc:
• Create custom verification buttons
• Assign/remove roles when users verify
• Support for multiple configurations (max 3)
help.system_selectroles_desc:
• Allow users to self-assign roles
• Role selection menus with descriptions and emojis
• Support for reactions, dropdowns, and buttons
help.system_timedroles_desc:
• Assign temporary roles that automatically expire
• Automated role management based on events
• Track active temporary roles per user
help.system_embeds_desc:
• Create fully custom embeds
• Save and load embeds
• Manage your saved embeds
help.system_leveling_desc:
• Earn XP from messages and voice
• Customizable level-up rewards
• Role rewards at specific levels
help.systems_footer: All systems are ready to use once the setup is complete!
help.setup_intro: Follow these steps to configure Sloth for your server:
help.setup_step1_title: Step 1: Choose systems to configure with /systems
help.setup_step1_desc:
All systems are available free to use:
• Log Channel, Warning, Ticket, Moderation, Statistics
• Role Systems (Select Roles, Timed Roles, Verify)
• Leveling System with role rewards
• Configure only the ones you need with /systems
help.setup_step2_desc:
**Log Channel:** `/log-channel set #channel`
**Warning System:** `/warn settings-set`
**Ticket System:** `/ticket setup`
**Moderation:** Ready to use with `/mod` commands!
**Timed Roles:** Use `/role-event create` to automate
**Leveling:** Use `/level settings` to configure
help.setup_step3_desc:
**Ticket Panel:** `/ticket panel` - Creates user-friendly ticket creation
**Embeds:** `/embed create` - Creates an embed to edit
**Verify Button:** `/verify-button add` - Creates standalone verification button
**Select Roles:** `/select-roles send` - Creates role selection menu
help.setup_step4_desc:
• Ensure staff have appropriate Discord permissions
• Bot needs Admin permissions for flawless functionality
• Configure role-based access for tickets
help.setup_formatting_desc:
Need help formatting your rules descriptions? Use Discord markdown!
📝 Click the 🎨 Formatting button below for a complete guide.
help.setup_footer: Need help? Create a support ticket!

`/mod kick` `/mod ban` `/mod unban` - User management
`/mod timeout` `/mod untimeout` - Temporary restrictions
`/mod purge` - Delete multiple messages
`/mod slowmode` - Set channel slowmode

`/warn user` - Issue warning to user
`/warn list` - List active warnings of a user
`/warn settings-set` - Configure warning thresholds
`/warn settings-get` - View warning configuration
help.commands_log_desc:
`/log-channel set` - Configure logging channel
`/log-channel get` - View current log channel

`/ticket setup` - Configure ticket system
`/ticket panel` - Create ticket creation panel
`/ticket config` - Set custom title and description for ticket panel
`/ticket close` - Close current ticket
`/ticket assign` - Assign to staff member

`/ticket info` - Get ticket information
help.commands_stats_desc:
`/stats lifetime` - Lifetime server statistics
`/stats today` - Today's server statistics

`/stats date` - Statistics for specific date
`/stats user` - View user information and statistics
help.commands_page2_footer: Page 2 of 5 • All commands require appropriate permissions

`/select-roles add` - Add role to selection list
`/select-roles remove` - Remove role from selection list
`/select-roles send` - Send role selection interface
*Supports reactions, dropdowns, and buttons*
help.commands_timedroles_desc:
`/my-roles` - View your active temporary roles
`/temprole add/remove` - Manually manage temporary roles
`/role-event create/list` - Manage automated role events for (timed) roles
help.commands_verify_desc:

help.formatting_intro: Learn how to format your embed descriptions using Discord markdown:
help.formatting_basic_desc:
• `**bold text**` → **bold text**
• `*italic text*` → *italic text*
• `__underlined text__` → __underlined text__
• `~~strikethrough~~` → ~~strikethrough~~
• `||spoiler text||` → ||spoiler text||
help.formatting_code_desc:
• `` `inline code` `` → `inline code`
• ` ```code block``` ` → Multi-line code blocks
• ` ```language\ncode``` ` → Syntax highlighted code
help.formatting_lists_desc:
• `• Bullet point` → Bullet lists
• `1. Numbered item` → Numbered lists
• `> Quote text` → Block quotes
• `>>> Multi-line quote` → Multi-line quotes
help.formatting_links_desc:
• `[Link Text](https://example.com)` → Clickable links
• `<@userid>` → User mentions
• `<#channelid>` → Channel mentions
• `<@&roleid>` → Role mentions
help.formatting_special_desc:
• `:emoji_name:` → Discord emojis
• `<:name:id>` → Custom server emojis
• `\n` → Line breaks in descriptions
• `\*` → Escape special characters
help.formatting_tips_desc:
• **Titles**: Only support plain text (no formatting)
• **Descriptions & Footers**: Support all Discord markdown
• Use **bold** for rule headers
• Use `code blocks` for examples
• Keep descriptions under 4096 characters
• Use line breaks (\n) for better readability
• Test formatting before publishing
help.leveling_guide_intro: The Leveling System allows your members to earn XP and level up through activity on your server.
help.leveling_how_it_works_desc:
Members earn XP by:
• **Sending messages** in text channels
• **Being active in voice channels**
• **Adding reactions** to messages

When enough XP is accumulated, users level up and can receive role rewards!
help.leveling_commands_desc:
`/leveling rank` - View your or another user's rank card
`/leveling leaderboard` - View the server's top members
`/leveling settings` - Open the settings panel (Admin)
help.leveling_settings_intro: Use `/leveling settings` to access a comprehensive settings panel with the following options:
help.leveling_formula_desc:
**XP Curve:** Choose between Linear, Exponential, or Logarithmic progression
**Multiplier:** Adjust how quickly or slowly users level up
**Max Level:** Set a cap or allow unlimited levels
help.leveling_message_xp_desc:
**Mode:** Random (between min/max) or Fixed XP per message
**XP Range:** Set minimum and maximum XP values
**Cooldown:** Time between XP-earning messages (prevents spam)
help.leveling_voice_xp_desc:
**XP per Minute:** How much XP is earned in voice channels
**Minimum Members:** Require multiple people in the channel
**Anti-AFK:** Require users to be unmuted to earn XP
help.leveling_reaction_xp_desc:
**Awards:** Choose who gets XP - sender, receiver, or both
**XP Amount:** Set XP earned per reaction
**Cooldown:** Prevent reaction spam
help.leveling_notifications_desc:
**Announcement Channel:** Where level-up messages are posted
**DM Notifications:** Send level-ups via direct message
**Custom Messages:** Set personalized level-up messages
help.leveling_rewards_desc:
**Add Rewards:** Assign roles at specific levels
**Stack Mode:** Keep all earned roles, or replace with highest
**Manage Rewards:** View and remove configured rewards
help.leveling_exceptions_desc:
**Ignored Channels:** Channels where XP isn't earned
**Ignored Roles:** Roles that don't earn XP
**On Leave Behavior:** Keep or reset XP when members leave
help.leveling_enter_level: Enter the level for this reward
